top_news.title: ProToMEx: Rapid, Interpretable Explanations via Structured Representations
top_news.dek: ProToMEx introduces a new explainability paradigm using Probabilistic Topic Modeling to identify complex, combinatorial patterns in classifier decisions.
top_news.brief: Traditional post-hoc explainers often rely on simple feature attribution, which fails to capture the nuanced logic behind model predictions. ProToMEx addresses this by leveraging structured representations to articulate how specific combinations of features drive decision-making, offering a more interpretable alternative for complex machine learning models.

top_news.title: Show HN: Engrim – A universal, local-first SQLite memory engine for AI CLIs
top_news.dek: Engrim is a local-first SQLite memory engine designed to provide a universal, project-scoped episodic memory standard for AI CLI tools.
top_news.brief: Engrim aims to eliminate cloud lock-in for AI agents by using SQLite as a local storage backend. It is compatible with various AI coding assistants and CLI environments, allowing developers to maintain persistent, project-specific memory without relying on external proprietary services.
top_news.image_alt: Engrim project logo and CI status badges

top_news.title: Axis Robotics Releases AXIS: A Browser-Based Data Engine With 207 Robot Manipulation Tasks and 50,129 Trajectories
top_news.dek: Axis Robotics introduces AXIS, a browser-based data engine featuring 207 robot manipulation tasks and over 50,000 verified trajectories.
top_news.brief: AXIS shifts robot demonstration collection from lab hardware to web browsers, offloading compute to backend GPUs. The dataset includes 50,129 Franka trajectories. Benchmarks show that continual pretraining with this data improves the π0.5 model's performance on LIBERO-Plus from 83.9 to 88.8, outperforming volume-matched RoboCasa365 controls.
top_news.image_alt: Robot manipulation task interface in a web browser

top_news.dek: OpenBMB releases MiniCPM5-2B, a dense 2B parameter Transformer model built on the MiniCPM5 training recipe.
top_news.brief: MiniCPM5-2B is the latest addition to the MiniCPM5 series, following the 1B parameter version. It utilizes a dense Transformer architecture and is designed for efficient scaling, leveraging the same training methodology as its predecessor.

primary.title: Axis Robotics Releases AXIS: A Browser-Based Data Engine With 207 Robot Manipulation Tasks and 50,129 Trajectories
primary.summary: Robot datasets have grown far slower than the models trained on them, mostly because collection stays locked to lab hardware. AXIS moves demonstration collection into a web browser and pushes everything expensive to backend GPUs. The result is 207 tasks and 50,129 verified Franka trajectories, and continual pretraining that lifts π0.5 from 83.9 to 88.8 on LIBERO-Plus while a volume-matched RoboCasa365 control reaches only 57.5. The post Axis Robotics Releases AXIS: A Browser-Based Data Engine With 207 Robot Manipulation Tasks and 50,129 Trajectories appeared first on MarkTechPost.

primary.title: Meta FAIR Introduces AI Research Preference Models (RPMs): Ranking ML Experiments Before Spending GPU Hours
primary.summary: AI research agents can propose far more experiments than they can afford to run. Meta FAIR, Oxford and UCL introduce AI Research Preference Models — frozen LLM judges that rank 15 unexecuted candidates and execute only one. On AIRS-Bench, the average normalized score rises from 0.684 to 0.729, and the baseline's 24-hour result arrives in roughly 15 hours.
